verdict.rationale: Ente Auth does not document choosing a region for its hosted cloud. It does document its own ways to control where data lives: an offline mode that keeps codes only on the device, a custom location for local backups, and self-hosting docs for running Ente Auth on your own machine. missing for 10: selectable cloud storage region or residency guarantee for Ente's hosted sync, in-depth self-hosting storage-location docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: In offline mode, your codes are stored only on that device.
Custom backup location: Choose where to store your backups on your device.
Alternatively, if using Ente Auth, get started by adding an account (assuming you are running Ente Auth at `http://<machine-ip>:3003` or `http://localhost:3003`).
